title: 2 Queens Lose??
reviewNotes: All 27 diagrams/captions re-reviewed, including native21 after Kxh3 at 99 seconds. Complete fourteen-piece Black-to-move root retains both white queens, Rh4 and all seven surviving pawns. Rh1+/Kg4/f5+/Kh5/g6 mate is proved with every White defense enumerated: both king replies are forced. Practice remains Black to move and win; expected White outcomes are losses. Earlier Qxf2 sacrifice and rook-return defenses remain unverified context.
